data: Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $13.64 for fiscal 2025 (year ended June 30, 2025), compared with $11.80 for fiscal 2024, an increase of about 16%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was $101.8 billion, up from $88.1 billion in fiscal 2024, a gain of roughly 16%. These figures come from my recall of Microsoft's reported results rather than a live lookup of the filing, so please verify them against the fiscal 2025 Form 10-K before relying on them.
